Col ES Sanford Care Jno Horner N Y. Wash Nov 29th 1865. 1130 AM
Your letter received this morning Zebra I intend to
remove all restrictions from commercial business including special press
wicks on the first of December pedlar at the
same time I shall exercise a super vision unknown
tooth public or press & I have so notified
the Military wrangle men Zodiac You can make arrangements
to take all the business you can get Zebra
Every thing will be done to facilitate its transmission
unity I desire that this be not published Yoke
Thos. T. Eckert
